title: Becoming an American State National
summary: Interview promoting American State National status: claims the US was incorporated in 1871, citizens are traded as bonds, and status correction frees people from federal jurisdiction and debt.

assertions.quote: which forces you into their statutes and codes and bylaws and we are not part of that

verdicts.note: No legal process creates such a status; courts treat state-national claims as frivolous and apply federal and state law regardless.

assertions.quote: when they Incorporated the United States in 1871 you then became part of that 10 square mile Federal jurisdiction
we're traded on the bond market right which I mean if people have heard of pin Pimco and other municipal bonds
they're treating you as a commercial debt entity with your all caps name as an all caps incorporation
we do have a United States passport but we have I believe limited diplomatic immunity

verdicts.note: US passports confer no immunity; state-national documents carry no legal weight and holders are arrested like anyone else.

assertions.quote: it's a foreign corporation for which that money is going to the international monetary Fund in the world bank

verdicts.note: The IRS is a bureau of the US Treasury and tax receipts go to the Treasury's general fund.
The IRS is organised under the Secretary of the Treasury to administer the internal revenue laws, not a private or foreign corporation; the document does not trace where receipts are deposited.

assertions.quote: We're free people now we're on the law of the land God's law law of nature that is the superior court
two and a half million Americans last year corrected their status as well

verdicts.note: There is no legal status change to record; the figure is unsourced and no government recognises such corrections.
